provenance: Original concise public-grammar notes; no implementation or upstream tests inspected or copied
publicCategories: Command invocations contain a command name and parenthesized arguments
Quoted, bracket and unquoted arguments have different expansion rules
Comments and separating whitespace are not arguments

nativePolicy.units: Raw command names, parentheses and whole arguments; kind retained
nativePolicy.default: Exact raw spellings; command case, escapes and argument whitespace remain significant
nativePolicy.ignoreIdentifiers: Command names and plain ASCII unquoted identifiers
nativePolicy.ignoreLiterals: Static nonidentifier arguments; preserve kind, dynamic variable/environment/cache references and any $< generator marker
nativePolicy.limits: 100,000 per-file tokens plus shared clone and source budgets
nativePolicy.semantics: No execution, expansion, binding resolution or semantic-equivalence claim
